build_game_tree: build a pygraphviz game tree from a pyspiel game with configurable depth limit and node/edge decorators
create_default_node_decorator: create a default node decorator that styles game tree nodes by player, terminal state, and chance node
create_default_edge_decorator: create a default edge decorator that labels and colors edges by player action
visualize_game_tree_svg: visualize a game tree as SVG in Jupyter notebooks or Google Colab with automatic layout
group_infosets_game_tree: group game tree nodes by infosets or public sets using clustered subgraphs
